DIAGNOSIS READY: Auricular Chondritis (Ear Canal Chondritis) secondary to prior tympanoplasty.

The reported pain when wearing earrings and shooting pain upon eating suggests inflammation of the auricular cartilage or involvement of the auriculotemporal nerve. I will proceed with this diagnosis as the clinical picture matches the post-surgical complication rather than the unverified request for a completely different condition.
